summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including improvements to the Spark integration and REST client encoding issues. Key topics include offloading snapshots from metadata, fine-grained access control, and enhancements to OAuth2 support.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Java REST client encoding issues with namespace and table identifiers
Proposal to offload snapshots from metadata.json
Discussion on fine-grained access control for REST catalogs
